info.title: ADTModelGenerator
info.description: Provides the ADTModelGenerator command-line utility to inspect a zip file containing a RTDT model and generate an Azure Digital Twins JSON model definition.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Generates an Azure digital twins model file with ScaleOut real-time digital twin component based on ScaleOut real-time digital twin definition.

options.name: --adt_model_id
options.description: The name of an Azure digital twin model identifier.

options.name: --sdt_model_type
options.description: The name of the ScaleOut digital twin model type in format "mymodelassembly.dll, namespace.modelclassname".

options.name: --sdt_message_type
options.description: The name of the twin's message type in format "mymessageassembly.dll, namespace.messageclassname".

options.name: --display_name
options.description: The Azure digital twin model display name.

options.name: --rtdt_zip_file_path
options.description: The path to a ScaleOut real-time digital twin model zip file that contains either the model.json or appsettings.json file as well as all the binaries used by a real-time digital twin assembly. This zip file will be updated at the end of a successful run to add the 'AzureDigitalTwinModelName' parameter with the 'adt_model_id' value.

options.name: --adt_model_json_file_path
options.description: The path to the output JSON file that contains both Azure digital twin model definition file with embedded ScaleOut component.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates an Azure digital twin model.

options.name: --adt_model_file_path
options.description: The path to an Azure digital twin model file.
